m: 1. ली (cf. √ री) cl. 9. P. (Dhātup. xxxi, 31) लिनाति, to adhere, obtain (not usually found); cl. 1. P. लयति (xxxiv, 6), to melt, liquefy, dissolve (not usually found); cl. 4. Ā. (xxvi, 30) लीयते (Ved. also लायते; pf. लिल्ये, लिल्युः, Br. &c.; लिलाय, ललौ Gr.; aor. अलेष्ट, ŚBr.; अलैषीत्, अलासीत्, अलास्त Gr.; fut. लेता, लाता; लेष्यति or लास्यति, ˚ते, ib.; inf. लेतुम् or लातुम्, ib.; ind.p. -लायम्, AV.; Br.; लीय, MBh.; Kāv. &c.), to cling or press closely, stick or adhere to (loc.), MBh.; R. &c.; to remain sticking, Suśr.; to lie, recline, alight or settle on, hide or cower down in (loc.), disappear, vanish, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. P. लापयति or लाययति, to cause to cling &c., Br. &c.; Ā. लापयते, to deceive; to obtain honour; to humble, Pāṇ. i, 3, 70 : Desid. लिलीषति, ˚ते Gr.: Intens. लेलीयते, लेलयीति, लेलेति, ib. (cf. लेलाय).
2. ली f. clinging to, adhering &c., L.
= चपल, L.
a: ली — {vI.v} {c1c} P. (लयति) To melt, dissolve. {vII.v} {c9c} P. (लिनाति) 1 To adhere. --2 To melt, usually with वि. {vIII.v} {c4c} A. (लीयते, लीन) 1 To stick or adhere firmly to, cling to; M. 3. 5. --2 To clasp, embrace. --3 To lie or rest on, recline, stay or dwell in, lurk, hide, cower; (भृगांगनाः) लीयंते मुकुलांतरेषु शनकैः संजातलज्जा इव Ratn. 1. 26; हरिशिशुरुत्पतितुं द्रागंगान्याकुंच्य लीयते निभृतं Bv. 1. 106; R. 3. 9; Ś. 6. 16; Ku. 1. 12, 7. 21; Bk. 18. 13; Ki. 5. 26. --4 To be dissolved, melt away. --5 To be sticky or viscous. --6 To be absorbed in, be devoted or attached to; माधव मनसिजविशिखभयादिव भावनया त्वयि लीना Gīt. 4. --7 To vanish, disappear. --Caus. ( लापयति-ते, लाययति-ते, लीनयति-ते, लालयति-ते) To melt, dissolve, liquefy. (The form लापयते is used in the sense of ‘to honour’, ‘cause to be honoured’; जटाभिर्लापयते = पूजामधिगच्छति; cf. P. I. 3. 70).
लीः — f. 1 Adhering, clinging to. --2 Embracing. --3 Melting, dissolving.

m: लीला f. (derivation doubtful) play, sport, diversion, amusement, pastime, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
mere sport or play, child's play, ease or facility in doing anything, ib.
mere appearance, semblance, pretence, disguise, sham, Kāv.; Kathās.; Pur. (ibc. sportively, easily, in sport, as a mere joke ; also = लीलया ind. for mere diversion, feignedly)
grace, charm, beauty, elegance, loveliness, Kālid.; Kathās.; Rājat.
(in rhet.) a maiden's playful imitation of her lover, Daśar.; Sāh.; Pratāp.
a kind of metre (4 times ¯ ˘ ˘ ¯ ˘ ˘ ¯ ˘ ˘ ¯ ˘ ˘ ¯ ˘ ˘ ¯), Col.
N. of a Yoginī, HPariś.
a: लीला — [ली-क्विप् लियं लाति ला-क वा Tv.] 1 Play, sport, pastime, diversion, pleasure, amusement; क्लमं ययौ कंदुकलीलयापि या Ku. 5. 19; oft. used as the first member of comp.; लीलाकमलं, लीलाशुकः &c. --2 Amorous pastime, wanton, amorous or playful sport; उत्सृष्टलीलागतिः R. 7. 7; 4. 22; 5. 70; क्षुभ्यांति प्रसभमहो विनापि हेतोर्लीलाभिः किमु सति कारणे रमण्यः Śi. 8. 24; Me. 35; (लीला in this sense is thus explained by उज्ज्वलमणिः-अप्राप्तवल्लभसमागमनायिकायाः सख्याः पुरोऽत्र निजचित्तविनोदबुद्ध्या . आलापवेशगतिहास्यविलोकनाद्यैः प्राणेश्वरानुकृतिमाकलयंति लीलाम् ..). --3 Ease, facility, mere sport, child's play; लीलया जघान ‘killed with ease’. --4 Appearance, semblance, air, mien; यः संयति प्राप्तपिनाकिलीलः R. 6. 72 ‘appearing like Pinākin’. --5 Beauty, charm, grace; मुहुरवलोकितमंडंनलीला Gīt. 6, R. 6. 1; 16. 71. --6 Pretence, disguise, dissimulation, sham; as, लीलामनुष्यः, लीलानटः &c. --Comp. --अ (आ) गारः --रं, --गृहं, --वेश्मन् n. a pleasure-house; R. 8. 95. --अंग a. having graceful limbs. --अंचित a. sportively handsome. --अब्जं, अंबुजं, --अरविंदं, --कमलं, --तारमसं, --पद्मं &c. ‘toy-lotus’, a lotus-flower held in the hand as a plaything; R. 6. 13; Me. 65, Ku. 6. 84. --अवतारः the descent (of Viṣṇu) on the earth for amusement. --उद्यानं {1} a pleasure-garden. {2} the garden of gods, Indra's paradise. --कलहः ‘sportive quarrel’, a sham or feigned quarrel; cf. प्रणयकलह्. --चतुर a. sportively charming; Ku. 1. 47. --नटनं a sportive dance. --मनुष्यः a sham man, a man in disguise. --मात्रं mere sport or play, child's play, absence of the least effort. --रतिः f. diversion, sport. --वज्रं an instrument like Indra's thunderbolt. --वापी a pleasure-tank. --शुकः a parrot kept for pleasure. --साध्य a. to be effected with ease, easy of accomplishment.

k.v: हेला लीलेत्यमी हावाः क्रियाः शृङ्गारभावजाः। द्रवकेलिपरीहासाः क्रीडा लीला च नर्म च॥
हेला लीलेत्यमी हावाः क्रियाः शृङ्गारभावजाः। द्रवकेलिपरीहासाः क्रीडा लीला च नर्म च॥
लीला विलासक्रिययोरुपला शर्करापि च। शोणितेऽम्भसि कीलालं मूलमाद्ये शिफाभयोः॥
लीला विलासक्रिययोरुपला शर्करापि च। शोणितेऽम्भसि कीलालं मूलमाद्ये शिफाभयोः॥

m: लीला˚भरण (˚लभ्˚) n. an ornament worn for mere pleasure (of no intrinsic value, as a bracelet of lotuses), Śak.
लीला—धर-भट्ट m. N. of an author, Cat.
लीला—खेल mfn. moving or sporting playfully, Ragh.
लीला—खेल n. a kind of metre, Col.
लीला˚ङ्ग (लाङ्ग) mfn. (accord. to Nīlak.) = विलचितान्ग, having playful limbs (said of a bull; but prob.) w.r. for नीलाङ्ग, q.v., MBh.
लीला—शुक m. ‘pleasure-parrot’, a parrot kept for pl˚, A.
N. of the poet Bilva-maṅgala, Cat.
लीला˚ब्ज (˚लाब्ज) n. = -कमल above, Kuval.
लीला˚चल (˚आच्˚) m. N. of a district, Cat.
लीला—चन्द्र m. N. of a poet, Subh.
लीला—चतुर mfn. sportively charming, Kum.
लीला—दग्ध mfn. burnt or consumed without effort, Bhartṛ.
लीला—देवी f. N. of a princess, Inscr.
लीला˚द्रि (˚लाद्रि) m. = लीलाचल above, Cat.
लीला˚गार (˚लाग्˚; Ragh.) or लीला—गृह (Kathās.; Naiṣ.) or लीला—गेह (Kathās.), n. a pleasure-house, place of amusement or sport.
लीला—कलह m. a quarrel or dispute in play, sham-fight, Śṛṅgār.
लीला—कमल n. a woman's toy-lotus, a lotus-flower held in the hands as a plaything, Kāv.
लीला—कर m. a partic. metre, VarBṛS., Sch.
लीला—मानुष-विग्रह mfn. having or taking a human form merely for amusement or in mere semblance (said of Kṛṣṇa), ib.
लीला—मात्रेण ind. out of mere sport, in mere play, without the least effort, Pañcar.
लीला—मधु-कर m. N. of a drama (IW. 471).
लीला—मन्दिर n. a pleasure-house, Daś.
लीला—मनुष्य m. a sham man, one not really a man, BhP.
लीला—मय mfn. consisting of or relating to play or amusement (comp.), Cat.
लीला˚म्बुज (˚लाम्˚) n. = -कमल above, Kathās.
लीला—नटन n. a sportive dance, MW.
a sham or pretended dance, Pañcat.
लीला—नृत्य n. id., Kāvyād.
लीला—पद्म n. = -कमल above, Sāh.; Kāvyād.
लीला—पर्वत m. N. of a mountain, Kathās.
लीला—पुर n. N. of a town, Inscr.
लीला—रस-क्रम-स्तोत्र n. N. of wk.
लीला—रति f. sportive amusement, am˚ with (loc.), Kāv.
लीला˚रविन्द (˚लार्˚) n. = -कमल above, Ragh.; Kathās.
लीला—साध्य mfn. to be effected with ease, Kathās.
लीला—सम्पादन-क्रम m. N. of wk.
लीला—स्वात्म-प्रिय m. N. of an author held in esteem by the Tāntrikas, Cat.
लीला—ताण्डव-पण्डित mfn. skilled in sportive dances (said of Śiva), MW.
लीला—ताल m. (in music) a kind of measure, Saṃgīt.
लीला—तामरस n. = -कमल above, Kāv.
लीला—तनु f. a form assumed for mere sport or pleasure, BhP.
लीला—वापी f. a pleasure-tank or lake, Kathās.
लीला˚वधूत (˚लाव्˚) mfn. gracefully waved about, Megh.
लीला—वज्र n. an implement or instrument shaped like a thunderbolt, Kathās.
लीला—वत् mfn. possessed of grace or beauty, graceful, charming, Hcat. (only f.), Col.
a: लीलावत् — a. 1 Sportive, playful. --2 Beautiful, graceful. --ती 1 A charming or handsome woman. --2 An amorous or wanton woman. --3 N. of Durgā. --4 N. of a wellknown mathematical work by Bhāskarāchārya. --5 N. of the wife of the demon Maya.

m: लीला˚वतार (˚लाव्˚) m. the descent (of Viṣṇu on the earth) for his own amusement, BhP.

of the wife of the Asura Maya, Kathās.
of a Surāṅganā, Siṃhās.
of a wife of Avīkṣita, MārkP.
of a merchant's daughter, Hit.
a kind of metre, Col.

लीला—व˚ती-रहस्य n. N. of wk.

a: लीन — p. p. [ली-क्त] 1 Clung or adhered to, stuck to. --2 Lurking, hid, concealed. --3 Resting or reclining on; Ś. 6. 16. --4 Melted, dissolved; Māl. 5. 10. --5 Completely absorbed or swallowed up in, intimately united with; नद्यः सागरे लीना भवंति. --6 Devoted or given up to. --7 Disappeared, vanished; (see ली).
